title:
WE SPENT A DAY BRINGING TOYS
TO KIDS IN AN ISRAELI HOSPITAL
beats: HOOK: girl in the corridor squeezing her new plush with both arms, face at 0.0s. "Is this the one you want? Feel better" / "Thank you so much"
little boy walks off with his dinosaur Lego; Tal calls "come give me a hug" and he runs back into it (hug 34.5-37.5)
STRONGEST, slot 3: WIDE - Miss Israel lifts her own crown and turns to put it on the girl
CLOSE (synced, close = wide + 7.60s): crown on, the girl adjusts it, her mother smiling at 76.0 - held, no caption
the support: boy in bed before ear surgery - "Are you scared?" "A little?" "Don't be scared. We love you."
girl in pajamas walks into Miss Israel's arms, plush under her arm - wordless hug
a religious father hugs Tal at the bedside - "Feel better" / "Well done, all of you"
teenage patient on her bed grinning with a green plush - 1.9s breath, wordless
Muslim mother with her baby: "This is your baby?" "Yes" "Wow" "Thank you" "Inshallah she will feel better" "Inshallah"
parents laughing while their daughter unwraps: "We love you. We really love you." - their faces are the beat
ENDING: the bed-boy's father, smiling: "Happy holiday, happy new year. Keep doing good. With love." Out on the full stop of "with love"
